name: good first issue
description: Starter issue: well-scoped, mentored, and meets the starter checklist in docs/community

name: difficulty: beginner
description: Small, isolated change; about 1-4 hours; no Stellar or Soroban knowledge needed

name: difficulty: intermediate
description: Touches several modules or needs Stellar/Horizon familiarity; about 1-3 days

name: difficulty: advanced
description: Cross-cutting design, security-sensitive paths, or protocol expertise; multi-day

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers welcome an outside contributor to pick this up

name: security
description: Wallet, auth, or crypto paths; needs a CODEOWNERS review and is never a starter issue

name: skip-bundle-check
description: CI: bypass the bundle size budget; the PR must explain why

name: generate-bundle-report
description: CI: upload the bundle visualizer report as an artifact
